Get To Know Us

About Us

From the DMs to a real storefront

This is a starter draft — swap this copy for your own words whenever you're ready.

Sosa Links started the way most real ones do — DMs, FaceTime pics, and word of mouth around Central Florida. No storefront, no ads, just real Cuban link sets going out to real customers who wanted the look without the middleman markup.

Every piece is hand-selected for weight, finish, and gold plating that's actually built to last — not the thin flash-plate stuff that fades in a month. Chain and bracelet always come from the same batch, so what you get matches, every time.

This site is the next step — same direct-to-you service, same standard, now with a real storefront to match. Drop 3 is live. More is coming.

— SOSA LINKS, CENTRAL FLORIDA
